# DISC — Discovery

- Owner: `ticonnect-net`
- Stage: 4
- Layer: `services`
- Component graph: [generated/components/disc.md](generated/components/disc.md)

## Purpose

Advertise this node and produce candidate peers over mDNS with UDP broadcast fallback. Candidates are hints, not trust.

## Boundary

Owns sockets and candidate cache. Does not pair, connect, or authenticate. Emits candidates to transport.

## Owned state

- candidate cache

## Invariants

- `INV-DISC-1` — Discovery produces candidates only and never implies trust. Test: crates/net/tests/discovery.rs
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check

## Failure semantics

- malformed packets dropped and counted
- candidate caps enforced
- mDNS failure falls back to broadcast

## Open decisions

- candidate expiry is three beacon intervals
- transport port remains 0 until Stage 5
- IPv6 discovery is deferred; Stage 4 is IPv4-only
